annotations.title: Export a design system for Claude Design

description: Writes a design system in Claude Design's Design System format (project/design-system.json, project/tokens.json, project/README.md) into <output folder>/claude-design/<id>/, checked against that format, plus a brand.html page (the showcase, marks, voice, do and don't) registered as an artifact. For the user's own brand it also copies the logo, icons and licensed font files to project/assets/ and adds a fonts note; a reference system gets no marks. Writes files only: publish them with your Artifact tool to make a Claude Design System artifact. Works for bundled and custom systems.

by.description: Optional: who the export is recorded for in Claude's lastChange.

designSystemId.description: The design system to export, e.g. user:acme. Default: the active one.
